decision: Use a fresh xmin selected together with the full target row; validate exact source/lifecycle; guard draft-to-review UPDATE by the observed xmin; require one exact returned row. Publication continues to use full expected-review-document CAS in existing promote_story_spec_v2 RPC.
qualification: Read-only probes establish select/filter availability, not a completed guarded UPDATE. xmin is an immediate row-version guard, not durable identity. No runtime, schema, matching or database changes made by this probe.
